page_title: ATA 0-2 INT | Atalanta v Inter 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+8' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Yann Sommer stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
90+5' Davide Massa blows his whistle and Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90+1' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Hakan Calhanoglu walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
90+1' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joaquin Correa (Inter) replacing Lautaro Martinez.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcus Thuram departs the field of play to be replaced by Mehdi Taremi (Inter).

90+1' Davide Frattesi (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
90' There will be a minimum of 11 min. of added time.
88' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Gian Piero Gasperini, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!

87' 0 - 2 Goal! Nicolo Barella plays in Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 0:2.
86' What was Benjamin Pavard (Inter) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
86' Yann Bisseck (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
83' Substitution. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ademola Lookman walks off.
83' The corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
81' Yet another yellow card and Ederson (Atalanta) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Davide Massa doesn't allow any discussions.
81' Ederson (Atalanta) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
80' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
79' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) for his blatant foul.
77' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
75' A substitution has been made. Henrikh Mkhitaryan goes off and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on.
74' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Berat Djimsiti will be replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
74' Substitution. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) in, Mateo Retegui out.
74' A pass by Marcus Thuram (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
72' Goal disallowed! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) scores but Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
69' Poor challenge! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is penalised for tripping and Davide Massa blows his whistle. Inter win a free kick.
66' Substitution. Denzel Dumfries is replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
66' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
64' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi is alert and makes a decent save.
62' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
60' A long pass finds Ederson (Atalanta) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
59' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) replaces Mario Pasalic.
59' Substitution. Raoul Bellanova walks off the pitch and Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
59' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.
57' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

57' A lofted cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.

54' 0 - 1 Carlos Augusto (Inter) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
54' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
54' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
50' The game is interrupted.
47' Marcus Thuram (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
41' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
39' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' Total attempts – 5:5.
30' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
28' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
28' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

23' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta). Davide Massa saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Inter win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
20' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
20' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will deliver the corner kick.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.

19' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Yann Sommer dived superbly to block a header by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Yann Sommer pulled off a remarkable save! Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
16' A dangerous looking corner kick from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is cleared to safety by the defence.

16' Carlos Augusto (Inter) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
15' A pass from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
14' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
11' Marcus Thuram (Inter) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
8' Looks like Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
7' Marcus Thuram (Inter) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
6' The game is interrupted as Nicolo Barella (Inter) is flagged offside.
5' Davide Massa blows his whistle as Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
2' Marcus Thuram (Inter) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Davide Massa.
